evidence_note: Dimension callouts transcribed from organizer images by a vision model (see derived/vision-transcripts/2026-10-29/) and cross-checked against the revision history, the V2 drawing and the rendered arena guide PDF. Small digits and fractions still merit human confirmation.

coordinate_frame.x_axis: along 96-inch nominal base toward racecourse end
coordinate_frame.z_axis: up from top surface of base

walls.confirmed_by: vision transcription of V3 drawing image4.JPG, 2026-10-29

center_divider.confirmed_by: vision transcription of V3 drawing image4.JPG, 2026-10-29; June-2026 guide and V2 drawing show 1 x 1 x 36

track_marking_callouts_in.note: octagonal racecourse marking labels from the V3 drawing

pit_boxes.source: V3 drawing labels transcribed 2026-10-29; physical boundaries still require validation

pit_transition_spans_in.right_edge_cluster_confirmed_by: 4/4 multi-model vote 2026-10-29 (17in, not 7in; one model pixel-scale-verified ~17-19 in)
pit_transition_spans_in.reference_surfaces: unverified; the 15.02-in span runs from the checkered notch edge to the right edge per vision reading

obstacles.quadrant_arrangement_confirmed_by: image8.tmp photo overlays: two quadrants per lane either side of the center divider
